name: Hotel-Restaurant Ursprung
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Hotel-Restaurant Ursprung in Wald im Pinzgau**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps, **Wald im Pinzgau** offers a perfect blend of breathtaking nature and authentic Tyrolean charm. At **Hotel-Restaurant Ursprung**, you’ll experience warm hospitality, hearty regional cuisine, and stunning mountain views.

Indulge in traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a hearty **Kaspressknödel**, all crafted with local ingredients. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the **Zillertal** or **Salzkammergut**, unwind in our cozy restaurant with a glass of **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** or a steaming cup of **Kaffee mit Schlag**.

Our family-run establishment is the ideal retreat for nature lovers, food enthusiasts, and those seeking a true taste of **Tirol**. Whether you’re here for adventure or relaxation, **Hotel-Restaurant Ursprung** promises an unforgettable stay in one of **Tirol**’s most picturesque regions.
